stories.title: New model explains why glass becomes less transparent to terahertz light
stories.desc: Electromagnetic waves in the gigahertz (GHz) range, such as those used in mobile communications, can readily pass through many types of glass. However, transmission decreases significantly at terahertz frequencies above a characteristic threshold.

stories.title: Magnetic order survives weak quantum fluctuations in gapless magnets
stories.desc: In a new study published in Physical Review Letters, researchers have shown that magnetic order can survive weak quantum fluctuations in disordered magnets that lack an energy gap. stories.title: Mapping one atom's interaction with light uncovers an unbounded network of quantum states
stories.desc: A new graph-theoretic framework provides a unified description of atom-light interactions across regimes ranging from weak to deep-strong coupling.

stories.title: DarkSide detector puts 'nuclear' dark matter to the test
stories.desc: Researchers at the DarkSide collaboration have unveiled results from a seven-year experiment that tested whether dark matter particles could exist as composites of smaller, elementary particles. stories.title: Laser temporarily reprograms ultrathin optical device without electrodes
stories.desc: A tiny device that can be reprogrammed using a laser could lead to adaptable devices for computing, imaging and telecommunications. Most devices are built to perform a particular job. stories.title: Mathematicians Harness Randomness To Crack a 55-Year-Old Conjecture
stories.desc: After a long hiatus, the problem, which was likely inspired by juggling, has finally been resolved by a group of young mathematicians. The post Mathematicians Harness Randomness To Crack a 55-Year-Old Conjecture first appeared on Quanta Magazine

stories.title: Reducing Uncertainty in Groundwater Models Using Airborne Geophysics
stories.desc: Scientists present a probabilistic framework for exploiting airborne geophysical data for groundwater model parameterization and apply it to the Scott River aquifer system in Northern California.

stories.title: Uncovering the Valleys Hidden Below Greenland’s Ice
